visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: XOR Instead of a Search per Candidate
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every candidate number is searched for in the whole array with a nested loop. Use XOR: values that appear twice cancel out, leaving the missing number. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: x ^ x is 0 and x ^ 0 is x. XOR-ing every index and every value (plus n) cancels each present number twice and leaves only the missing one, in a single pass and with no extra memory.
